Print the WAL's entries

Usage: dolos sync dump [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --start <SLOT>     Start at the WAL entry at, or nearest to, this slot
      --limit <N>        How many entries to print; 0 prints them all [default: 100]
      --format <FORMAT>  How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text]
                         [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
